hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels with validateQuantityAtLocation checks each reservation input alone against available_quantity and never sums entries sharing (inventory_item_id, location_id). A cart with 3 OVS-PIECE plus 2 OVS-TWOPACK (4 WIDGET units) and another with 5 OVS-PIECE, against stock 10, should both pass the per-line check if they reserve sequentially under the lock: A reserves 5, then B's lines are each checked against 5 (3<=5, 4<=5), so reserved reaches 14 on 10 stock. Expect no_oversell to fail in some runs, likely reserved_matches_reservations to hold since both use the same counter path.

schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: multi-line-same-item-race
description: Two carts share WIDGET stock of 10 on one server; one holds a multi-line mix that sums past stock, completed together.

  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 1

  WIDGET: 10

    server: 1

      qty: 5
  cart-b:

      qty: 3
    - sku: OVS-TWOPACK
      qty: 2

- id: a-completes

  cart: cart-a
- id: b-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: cart-b
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 3
request_timeout_ms: 30000
